message.content:
Yes—**early Coca-Cola did contain cocaine**, because the original formula used coca leaf extract that included the drug.[1][7] Coca-Cola says that **today it does not contain cocaine**, and that cocaine has never been an added ingredient in its modern product.[2]

A useful distinction is that:
- **Late 1800s / early 1900s:** Coca-Cola used coca leaf material that contained cocaine.[1][7]
- **Today:** the coca leaf extract used for flavoring is *de-cocainized*, so the drink does not contain cocaine.[2][7]

If you want, I can also explain **when Coca-Cola stopped using cocaine** and how the formula changed over time.
